title: Orecchiette with Tuscan White Beans
subtitle: with fresh tomato foam and parmesan
description: Orecchiette tossed with creamy olive oil-poached white beans, served on a fresh tomato foam with parmesan and lemon zest.

steps.text: Drain the beans (soaked overnight), add cold water to cover by 5 cm and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook until the beans are soft but not falling apart, adding water as needed. Do not add salt at this stage.
Drain the beans and transfer to a shallow pot. Pour in enough olive oil to cover, add the sage and cook over low heat until the beans begin to break down. Season with salt and stir.
Blend the quartered tomatoes for about 5 minutes until a tomato foam forms. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and a pinch of salt, blend for another minute, then strain.
Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Transfer the beans (with a little of their oil) to a pan and heat. Add the pasta and toss gently. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Divide the pasta between plates, pour the tomato sauce around it, and sprinkle with grated parmesan and lemon zest.
